title: In the Waiting
subtitle: Finding God in the Long Middle
dedication: For everyone who is still waiting.
backCover: You asked God for something a long time ago. You are still waiting.

In the Waiting is a short, honest book for the long middle: the stretch between asking and knowing. It will not promise you the ending you want. It walks with you through the people in Scripture who waited: Abraham and Sarah, Joseph, Hannah, Martha and Mary, the exiles in Babylon, and those who died still trusting.
Twelve short chapters, each ending with two honest questions and a brief prayer, and a six-week guide for small groups.
